    Finite support of degrees extracted from orbit push-down maps #

    A linear map from a finite-dimensional space into a direct sum has only finitely many nonzero component maps. Applied objectwise to a transformation between Gabriel push-downs, and then combined with finite object support, this packages all extracted degree components as a genuine shift-orbit morphism.
